investigation_notes.Alert Name: Microsoft Defender: Antivirus Tampering Attempt Prevented
investigation_notes.Description: An attempt to stop the Microsoft Defender Antivirus service (WinDefend) using sc.exe was detected on WKSTN-FIN-092b from a privileged service account (GlobalAdmin_svc). The action was blocked and remediation reported as blocked/removed, so Defender remained active. The attempt indicates defense evasion by a high-privilege account and should be monitored for follow-on activity.
